payload.description_html:
Boclair lantern, Boclair flame, Red herring (local names from Réunion): species of fish found in the tropical waters of the Indian Ocean. It can measure up to 45cm and reach depths of 250m.

This fish was photographed during field sampling (SIH, Fisheries Information System) or laboratory dissections (research projects).

The photo in PNG format (without background) is available from the associated dataset.
